Axios and Symfony sample review

Verdicts: BENIGN for all three supplied samples.

Identification and provenance
- axios@0.18.0 SHA-256:
  d37954981d92d5bac6baa69e17131134ff1a8f103fdeae05f156d796b9141457
  Byte-identical to https://registry.npmjs.org/axios/-/axios-0.18.0.tgz
- Symfony Console Terminal.php SHA-256:
  2a76b37d75f6e3900a5d8f2f4878604de8a80696367f8f2c56e54da41ae3c5ab
  Byte-identical to Symfony Console v6.4.0 and v7.0.0 Terminal.php.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/symfony/console/v6.4.0/Terminal.php
- Symfony String AsciiSlugger.php SHA-256:
  298ff8a135c3c40898567d68ab5edf21e318defb0a3f3c75bd343e88766b2c55
  Byte-identical to Symfony String v6.4.0 Slugger/AsciiSlugger.php.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/symfony/string/v6.4.0/Slugger/AsciiSlugger.php

Behavior traced
Axios's entry exports an instance and selects the Node HTTP or browser XHR
adapter. Only caller requests dispatch network traffic. Request interceptors,
JSON serialization, configurable URLs, basic/proxy authentication, redirects,
response decompression, timeouts and cancellation implement the advertised
client. Browser cookie reads supply XSRF headers for same-origin or explicitly
credentialed requests. No fixed exfiltration destination, install hook, secret
harvesting, arbitrary code evaluator or process-launch payload was found.
The Base64 alphabet implements Basic authentication; minification and webpack
wrappers are ordinary build output. Both source maps contain 24 lib sources
identical to shipped sources after removing webpack footer comments.

Terminal's public dimension getters first use COLUMNS/LINES, then query the
terminal. On Windows it additionally parses ANSICON or fixed mode CON output.
The private process helper receives only fixed internal commands. shell_exec
runs fixed stty with stderr redirected; proc_open reads stdout through pipes
and closes the process. Environment strings are parsed, not interpolated into
commands. TERM/COLORTERM choose ANSI color depth. No HTTP request source,
backdoor command dispatch, network sink or persistence is present.

AsciiSlugger caches locale-specific ICU transliterators, optionally uses an
emoji transliterator or caller-supplied closure, converts text to ASCII,
replaces non-alphanumerics with the caller's separator and trims it. The
constructor accepts the closure; remote input does not create executable code.
Missing-package messages suggest composer commands but never run them. There
is no obfuscated payload, process execution or network operation.

Dependencies and references
Fetched and reviewed follow-redirects 1.3.0 / 1.15.11, is-buffer 1.1.5 / 1.1.6,
and the debug 3.1.0 / 3.2.7 and ms 2.0.0 / 2.1.3 runtime dependency chain.
These implement request redirection, Buffer recognition, diagnostic logging
and duration formatting. Reviewed Symfony AnsiColorMode, UnicodeString,
AbstractUnicodeString, AbstractString, SluggerInterface, LocaleAwareInterface,
EmojiTransliterator and GzipStreamWrapper upstream source. Emoji data paths
are constrained local resource paths; the wrapper loads local compressed
maps. The sample leaves emoji support disabled by default. Terminal's color
URLs are documentation comments; termstandard/colors was retrieved and
Wikipedia denied retrieval with HTTP 403. No payload reference was found.
No lockfile pins the npm dependency environment; reviewed versions are not a
claim about every possible historical or future dependency resolution.

Why the hostile source label may be wrong
No source-label rationale was supplied. These are unchanged upstream library
files that may have been collected from a malicious parent project. Shell
execution and cookie/network heuristics can also confuse capabilities with
abuse. Axios 0.18.0 has real vulnerabilities, including CVE-2019-10742's
failure to stop oversized responses, and npm marks it deprecated for security
reasons. Vulnerable software does not establish intentional hostile behavior.
https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-42xw-2xvc-qx8m

Detection corrections
- Move the unchanged withCredentials=true observation from exploit/file-upload
  to communications/http/auth; it proves neither upload nor CSRF. Update both
  direct objective consumers and the existing regression expectations. No
  other YAML consumer of the moved ID or its directory selects this atom.
- Replace file-wide quoted PHP execution-name co-occurrence with a distinct-
  name array query in metadata/file/function. Separate function_exists probes
  are not a list. Preserve the dynamic-check consumer with an honest
  co-occurrence description. Removing the old broad name fragments from
  shell/lang intentionally removes their use as execution evidence.
- Require a call for btoa; a function declaration alone is not an invocation.
- Match stty literals instead of comments; remove unsupported keylogging ATT&CK
  attribution. Keep the observation notable and in terminal interaction.
- Add scoped ICU Transliterator::create detection under string conversion.

Verification
Ran atomscan in slow mode and cleave facts on each original sample before
editing; inspected parsed literals, calls and source paths. Rescanned each
sample with the edited working-tree traits: zero hostile or suspicious
findings on all three. Focused positive, negative and migrated-consumer
controls are in cases.json; run python3 check.py from this directory, or
python3 testdata/triage/axios-symfony-controls/check.py from the repo root.
